description: The app's side navigation, with expanded, compact and collapsed versions.

howToUse: Use it for the main places of an app, always visible on the side: Home, Projects, Reports, Settings.
Split items into `groups`, mark the page open with `activeId`, and put the main creation action in `cta` ("New project").
Use `workspaces` to switch companies at the top, and `account` for the person at the foot.
alternatives: Areas inside a settings page: SettingsSubnav.
A site with few pages: NavigationMenu.

keyboard.action: Moves through the items, in reading order.
The workspace and account menus use the keys of WorkspaceSwitcher and Menu.

props.name: defaultActiveId
props.description: Initial active item (uncontrolled); clicking changes it on its own.

props.name: workspace
props.type: { name: string; role?: string | undefined; initials: string; } | undefined
props.description: Current workspace (static). Prefer `workspaces` for the full switcher.

props.name: workspaceId
props.description: Current workspace id when `workspaces` is used.

props.name: account
props.type: { name: string; email?: string | undefined; initials: string; seed?: string | undefined; src?: string | undefined; } | undefined

props.name: accountMenu
props.description: Account menu items (opens above the footer). Default: Profile/Settings/Sign out.

props.name: cta
props.type: { label: string; icon?: ReactNode; onClick?: (() => void) | undefined; href?: string | undefined; } | undefined
props.description: Primary CTA at the top (e.g. New project).

props.name: brand
props.description: Wordmark/logo shown at the top. Accepts text or markup (e.g. ``). Default `"refy"`.

props.name: mode
props.description: Controlled mode; `rail` shows icon + label and `compact` icon only.
